cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Sell the Disaster
cards.instruction: Make a terrible plan sound sensible, responsible, and inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Removing the restaurant roof solves ventilation permanently. Please compare the price with a whole extraction system, not one fan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We close. You must budget for safe operation, not wishful thinking.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The forecast says rain for our entire opening week.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then budget for zero opening-week wages. Put that in the savings column, please. We cannot reject the plan before you've counted its benefits.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 system comparison, A3 safe-operation budgeting and A5 savings classification make a disastrous roof plan sound professionally responsible.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 weather concern causes closure policy; B4 week forecast causes deletion of that week wages from the budget.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 test the plan against real restaurant operation, while A selectively counts benefits.

heightening.evidence: A5 makes the extent of B4 disaster into a reason not to reject the plan yet.

specificity.evidence: A1 ventilation project and B4 opening week state the decision and financial pressure.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 column instruction and refusal to reject the plan both serve the immediate persuasion, though it is a full final turn.
